AAPL.r_reason: Mega-cap, very stable cash flows, huge buybacks: close to an average-risk stock.
AAPL.name: Apple Inc.
AAPL.notes: TTM to Jun-2026. FCF margin is flattered by low cash taxes; normalised SBC-adjusted margin 24.5% base.

MSFT.r_reason: Diversified software and cloud with recurring revenue and a net cash balance sheet.
MSFT.name: Microsoft Corp.
MSFT.notes: FY26 (Jun-2026). Capex $116B cash (+finance leases) crushes current FCF; margin recovers as build-out matures.

GOOGL.r_reason: Strong balance sheet, but search faces AI disruption and regulatory risk.
GOOGL.name: Alphabet Inc. (Class A)
GOOGL.notes: TTM to Jun-2026. SBC and TTM revenue are estimates. 'extra' = $131.5B private equity stakes at a 50% haircut.

AMZN.r_reason: Thin retail margins and very heavy AI capex make free cash flow volatile.
AMZN.name: Amazon.com Inc.
AMZN.notes: TTM to Jun-2026. FCF negative on $169B capex. SBC estimated. Anthropic stake NOT valued (upside not counted).

NVDA.r_reason: Below the 11.5% chip-group rate: mega-cap, net cash and a dominant position. Still above average for cyclical AI spending, customer concentration and competition. 11-12% is also defensible.
NVDA.name: NVIDIA Corp.
NVDA.notes: TTM to Jul-2026 (FY27 Q2). SBC is an ESTIMATE (about 2.3% of revenue). Data-centre demand is highly cyclical and concentrated: lower confidence. Base case is deliberately below consensus growth. Base case is deliberately below consensus growth.

AVGO.r_reason: Chips plus a large recurring software business (VMware) lower the risk vs the chip group, offset by $35B net debt.
AVGO.name: Broadcom Inc.
AVGO.notes: TTM to Aug-2026 (FY26 Q3). SBC is an ESTIMATE (about 10% of revenue). Net debt from acquisitions. AI custom-chip demand drives growth.

LLY.r_reason: Large diversified pharma; obesity-drug growth is strong but competition and pricing pressure are rising.
LLY.name: Eli Lilly and Co.
LLY.notes: TTM to Jun-2026. SBC is an ESTIMATE. FCF is depressed by $9.9B capex on new plants; margin rises as the build-out matures. Growth rests on obesity drugs; pricing and patent risk.

ADBE.r_reason: Recurring subscription revenue, but generative AI threatens its creative-software moat.
ADBE.name: Adobe Inc.
ADBE.notes: TTM to Aug-2026 (FY26 Q3). SBC is an ESTIMATE (about 8% of revenue). The bear case assumes generative-AI tools erode its creative-software moat (sales shrink first, then recover slowly); the market price looks close to that view.

APP.r_reason: Very high margins that depend on one ad platform, short track record, regulatory and accounting scrutiny.
APP.name: AppLovin Corp.
APP.notes: TTM to Jun-2026. SBC is an ESTIMATE. Very high margins and heavy reliance on terminal value: lower confidence. Higher required return (11%) and 35% safety margin.

FICO.r_reason: Near-monopoly in credit scores, but pricing power is under regulatory pressure and it carries net debt.
FICO.name: Fair Isaac Corp.
FICO.notes: TTM to Jun-2026. SBC is an ESTIMATE (about 8% of revenue). Net debt of $5.4B from buybacks. Pricing power in credit scores faces regulatory scrutiny.

APA.r_reason: Above the 8.5% Energy rate: an oil producer with Egypt and exploration risk, net debt and oil-price dependence.
APA.name: APA Corporation
APA.notes: TTM to Jun-2026, earned at about $98/bbl realised oil: a cycle high, so every case assumes revenue falls and the cash margin shrinks from today's ~23% (after SBC) toward 10-20%. SBC from filings (~$0.15B/yr). Net debt $3.4B. Oil-price dependent: lower confidence, 10% required return and 35% safety margin.

DECK.r_reason: Fashion and brand risk (HOKA, UGG) and tariffs, partly offset by $1.1B net cash.
DECK.name: Deckers Outdoor Corp.
DECK.notes: TTM to Jun-2026. FY27 guidance: revenue $5.86-5.91B (high single digit growth), HOKA low-double-digit, UGG mid-single-digit, operating margin ~21.5% after ~150bp tariff drag. SBC is an ESTIMATE (~1% of revenue). $1.1B net cash, heavy buybacks. Fashion/brand risk: the bear case assumes HOKA growth stalls.

INCY.r_reason: Jakafi is ~60% of sales and loses patent protection later this decade.
INCY.name: Incyte Corp.
INCY.notes: TTM to Jun-2026, revenue cut by the one-off $246M Opzelura settlement benefit. Net cash $4.5B less ~$1.27B Vega (latarcibart) upfront due in Q3-2026. SBC from filings (~$0.26B/yr). Jakafi is ~60% of sales and faces loss of exclusivity later this decade, so the bear case has shrinking sales and lower margins; 35% safety margin.

MKC.r_reason: Below the 9% Consumer Defensive rate: spices are very stable demand. Note the pending Unilever Foods deal adds leverage risk.
MKC.name: McCormick & Co.
MKC.notes: TTM to Aug-2026. Trailing P/E is distorted by a one-off $867M gain on taking control of McCormick de Mexico (Jan-2026), so this model uses free cash flow. Organic growth ~3-6%. STANDALONE value only: the pending Unilever Foods combination (McCormick holders to own 35%, $15.7B cash to Unilever, close expected mid-2027) would change the per-share value substantially. Lower confidence.

QQQ.r_reason: Nasdaq-100 basket: diversified but tech-heavy, so slightly above an average stock.
QQQ.name: Invesco QQQ Trust (Nasdaq-100)
QQQ.notes: Look-through earnings model. Low-medium confidence: EPS inputs blend trailing GAAP (inflated by unrealised investment gains) and forward consensus.

GLD.name: SPDR Gold Shares

bear.why: Real yields stay >2.5%, USD firm; gold reverts toward the inflation-adjusted 1980 peak (~$3,300-3,500).

base.why: Range-bound near the 2026 trading range as real yields and central-bank buying offset.

bull.why: Fed pivots / inflation de-anchors; sell-side targets of $4,900-5,000 are reached.

GLD.notes: No cash flows => no intrinsic value. Scenario REFERENCE range only (low confidence); oz/share is an estimate.
